description: Starshipit shipping integration: rates from every courier on your Starshipit account, orders, labels, tracking and cancellations.

fields.description: Used for rates when a parcel has no size
fields.label: Default Parcel Template

fields.description: Printing a label is charged by the courier
fields.label: Allow Label Printing

fields.description: The time zone pickup times are booked in, as a zone name such as Australia/Perth. Empty for the pickup address's country's, or the system's.
fields.label: Pickup Time Zone

fields.description: Paste into Starshipit: Settings > Tracking & notifications > Webhook notifications
fields.label: Webhook URL

fields.description: Optional. Same secret as set in Starshipit
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Offer Starshipit rates to shoppers at checkout (Shop app)
fields.label: Rates at Store Checkout

fields.description: Tick if the rates Starshipit gives include tax (e.g. GST or VAT), as each courier is set up in Starshipit. A courier that says in its price breakdown whether tax is included is taken at its word. A rate for a parcel sent abroad carries no tax: the store charges it in full.
fields.label: Rates Include Tax

fields.description: The currency Starshipit's rates are in when its answer doesn't say. Empty for the company's currency.
fields.label: Rates Currency

fields.description: Starshipit prices a service at 0 when it has no rate for the parcel (a plain label carrier whose custom rates don't cover its weight or address). Tick only if a service priced at 0 really ships free.
fields.label: Offer Services Priced at 0 as Free

fields.description: Added to every rate at checkout, for what the courier's quoted price leaves out (e.g. a fuel surcharge invoiced later).
fields.label: Add to Checkout Rates (%)

fields.description: Added to every rate at checkout for each parcel the rate is for, in the store's currency (e.g. a handling fee, or fees invoiced later).
fields.label: Add to Checkout Rates (per Parcel)

fields.description: Service codes to offer, one per line. Empty offers every service
fields.label: Services at Checkout

fields.description: Dispatch address for checkout rates and Shipments of store orders, when the store's warehouse has none of its own
fields.label: Ship From Address

fields.description: Contact on Shipments created from store orders, when their warehouse has no Pickup Contact of its own
fields.label: Pickup Contact

fields.description: Description of Content on Shipments created from store orders, by any shipping provider
fields.label: Contents Description

name: Starshipit
